opinions.name: Claude Code
opinions.point: always returns to it after trying many alternatives
opinions.quote: I tried many; from opencode, warp, paseo, orca to openclaw, hermes, etc. I always end up returning to the default claude and codex.

opinions.name: Custom harness

opinions.name: OpenHands

opinions.name: Hermes Agent

opinions.name: ZCode

opinions.name: Z.ai (GLM)

opinions.name: Z.ai (GLM)

opinions.quote: recently I almost never run out of tokens before the weekly quota… resets… If you're used to throw every possible thought to an agent than most probably a light Z.ai subscription is not going to be enough.

opinions.name: Hermes Agent

opinions.name: Amp

opinions.quote: I like the direction in particular Amp is taking -- it was a tougher sell 6-8 months ago because you couldn't bring your own subs, but that is now longer a barrier

opinions.name: Claude Code
opinions.point: desktop app developer experience has improved
opinions.quote: mostly Zed as baseline thread / worktree manager using ACP to drive cluade/codex. Some use of the cluade/codex desktop apps directly as their dx has gottne better

opinions.name: Codex

opinions.name: Zed
opinions.point: neutral base avoiding reliance on lab tooling
opinions.quote: today: still zed as a base rather than relying too much on anthropic or openai tooling

opinions.name: Claude

opinions.name: DeepSeek

opinions.name: Open WebUI

opinions.name: GitHub Copilot

opinions.name: ChatGPT / Codex

opinions.name: Mistral

opinions.name: Claude

opinions.name: Chat UI (web/app)

opinions.quote: My interface with all tihs is claude native app because It provides nice things such as routines, computer use, etc. so it works kinda as a driver for everything.

opinions.name: Hermes Agent

opinions.quote: I use hermes as a "free" agent platforms as you can easily connect your chagpt sub and claude max plans come with api usage you can hook up.

opinions.name: Claude
opinions.point: subscription value far greater than API

opinions.name: Dots
opinions.point: not convinced it beats own solutions

opinions.name: Raven

opinions.name: Cline

opinions.name: DeepSeek

opinions.name: Kimi
opinions.point: cheaper and, mainly, fewer refusals

opinions.name: GLM
opinions.point: cheaper and, mainly, fewer refusals

opinions.name: Anthropic API

opinions.name: DeepSeek

opinions.name: Juggler
opinions.point: treats local and remote sessions the same

opinions.name: Orca

opinions.name: Claude

opinions.name: Argon

opinions.name: Cursor
